title: Evidence Task Engine
boundary: This is an investigation workflow, not an accusation system. A task records what public source to pull next, what the source can prove, what it cannot prove, and how the result changes confidence. Do not use this to publish private addresses, family details, live movement data, or unsupported criminal claims.

confidenceGrades.A: confirmed by primary public record, court record, official disclosure, regulatory filing, or authenticated exhibit
confidenceGrades.B: strong lead supported by reputable reporting or multiple records but missing a primary record

tasks.subject: EFTA01104262 capital-class map
tasks.nextPull: Verify each visible node, color label, and relationship line against the original PDF.
tasks.whatItCouldProve: That a name or institution appears as a map node or map label in the source file.
tasks.whatItCannotProve: Criminal conduct, payment, meeting, flight, knowledge, or a verified relationship type beyond the map label.
tasks.confidenceAfterIfVerified: A for map appearance only; C for relationship implication
tasks.privacyBoundary: No private address or family data. Association is not guilt.

tasks.subject: Dark Speculation Lab claims
tasks.currentRecord: Each claim has support standard, falsification test, risk rating and source routes.
tasks.nextPull: Attach one best proving source and one best counter-source to each high-risk claim.
tasks.whatItCouldProve: Whether a claim has a source route, public mechanism, court record, official statement or primary document.
tasks.whatItCannotProve: That a viral claim is true merely because it has symbols, screenshots or repeated online mentions.
tasks.confidenceAfterIfVerified: B/A only if primary source supports it; X if falsified
tasks.privacyBoundary: No doxxing, illegal material, private victim names or unsupported accusations.

tasks.whatItCouldProve: Where a reader should go to verify, falsify or classify a claim.
tasks.whatItCannotProve: The claim itself without a pulled record.
tasks.privacyBoundary: Only source routes and evidence classes, not private personal data.

tasks.subject: Public denial / response lane
tasks.currentRecord: Cards need denial/response routes before strong claims are made.
tasks.nextPull: Archive public statements, denials, corrections, institutional responses and counter-sources.
tasks.whatItCouldProve: What a person or institution publicly said, denied, corrected or admitted.
tasks.privacyBoundary: Do not harass or contact private individuals. Use public statements only.

tasks.subject: Evidence task status dashboard
tasks.nextPull: Count tasks by open, pulled, verified, rejected, needs counter-source and privacy blocked.
tasks.whatItCouldProve: How much of the tracker has been verified, what remains open and what was rejected.
tasks.whatItCannotProve: The truth of a claim without source records.
tasks.privacyBoundary: Do not expose private notes that contain sensitive personal data.

tasks.subject: Counter-source requirement
tasks.nextPull: For each high-risk card, find court rejection, official correction, misidentification, date error, fake-document warning or reputable debunk.
tasks.whatItCouldProve: That a claim should be downgraded, corrected, rejected or kept open.
tasks.whatItCannotProve: The opposite claim automatically; it narrows the evidence boundary.
tasks.confidenceAfterIfVerified: X for rejected claim or B/A for corrected boundary
tasks.privacyBoundary: Counter-sources must be cited without targeting private people.
